title: Just Initialize: A Training-Free Initialization Component for Large-Scale Routing Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2609.35443v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large-scale routing problems are difficult to solve efficiently as their search spaces grow rapidly with problem size. Existing approaches primarily improve the optimization procedure itself, often at increasing computational cost. We instead shift the focus to a useful initialization that can be refined into a high-quality solution with limited downstream refinement. We propose Just Initialize, a training-free and solver-agnostic initialization component for large-scale routing optimization. Just Initialize compresses a large routing instance into a compact surrogate space, optimizes its global routing structure, and recovers the resulting solution as an optimization-friendly starting point in the original space. Extensive experiments on Traveling Salesman Problems (TSPs), Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problems (CVRPs), Vehicle Routing Problems with Time Windows (VRPTWs), and Prize-Collecting Traveling Salesman Problems (PCTSPs) demon

translated_title: 直接初始化：一种面向大规模路径优化的免训练初始化组件
translated_abstract: 随着问题规模的增大，大规模路径问题的搜索空间迅速扩张，因而难以高效求解。现有方法主要致力于改进优化过程本身，但往往伴随着不断攀升的计算成本。与此不同，我们将研究焦点转向一种有用的初始化方式，它只需有限的后续优化即可被精炼为高质量解。我们提出了 Just Initialize，一种面向大规模路径优化的免训练且与求解器无关的初始化组件。Just Initialize 将大规模路径实例压缩到一个紧凑的代理空间中，优化其全局路径结构，并将所得解还原为原始空间中对优化友好的起始点。在旅行商问题、带容量约束的车辆路径问题、带时间窗的车辆路径问题以及带奖励收集的旅行商问题上开展的大量实验证明（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一种免训练且与求解器无关的初始化组件 Just Initialize，它通过将大规模路径实例压缩到紧凑的代理空间中优化全局路径结构，生成对优化友好的高质量起始点，从而以较低的计算成本高效求解大规模路径优化问题。
en_tdlr: Just Initialize is a training-free, solver-agnostic initialization component that compresses large routing instances into a compact surrogate space to optimize their global routing structure, yielding optimization-friendly starting points that enable efficient solving of large-scale routing problems with limited downstream refinement.
